description: Trivalent (M3+) oxide coating-dopant series from the v23 cascade (Li5.4PS4.4Cl1.6 host). Systematic ionic-radius sweep of M2O3 dopants (group-13 + Sc/Y + lanthanides), each run through the full cascade (screen -> anneal -> BVSE -> rerank -> EOS -> elastic -> e-hull -> ESW). Champion = rows[0] of each FINAL_RANKING.json (top combined score). This subset was NOT in doping_cascade_verified.json (which held the mono/divalent + Al batch); pulled from gabia 2026-06-15 to close the repo<->gabia sync gap.
_source: kserver116-27:/data/work/runs/multi_category_2026_05_26_v23/<M2O3>_<x>/FINAL_RANKING.json (rows[0]). UMA-s-1p1 task=omat. git_branch=claude/configure-spawn-halogen-lithium-TjDCB (git_dirty). Run 2026-06-07..2026-06-15. Values transcribed from the 2026-06-15 extraction table (rounded as printed); authoritative raw stays in the gabia FINAL_RANKING.json files.

method_notes.champion_pick: rows[0] = highest score_combined (weights: stability 0.4 + modulus 0.3 + mobility 0.3).
method_notes.de_post_anneal_eV_atom: Formation energy per atom vs undoped baseline AFTER 500 K anneal. Negative = more stable doping. (field de_per_atom_post_anneal)
method_notes.E_young_GPa: Young's modulus E_VRH from UMA relaxed-ion Cij (field E_young_GPa). UMA runs HIGH vs experiment (AFM/UPE 12-22 GPa) -> compare WITHIN cascade only (UMA-vs-UMA).
method_notes.B0_GPa: EOS Birch-Murnaghan bulk modulus (distinct from elastic B_hill).
method_notes.bvs_li_proxy: Bond-valence-sum Li mobility proxy (higher ~ more facile Li environment). field bvs_li_proxy.
method_notes.caveat_ALL_UMA: Every value here is UMA-s-1p1 screening. NO DFT yet. DFT validation of top picks (Gd/Y/Sc/Nd) required before any Paper#3 claim.

site_rule: ALL 26 trivalent champions sit on Li_24g (donor M3+ -> Li site) with O on S_16e (PS4 corner). 0 on Li_48h, 0 on P_4b. Robust M3+ site rule; consistent with Nd2O3 (Paper#2) and Y2O3 cross-validation.

Sc2O3._note: verified_json earlier listed Sc2O3 x002 de=-0.974 (Jun-9 snapshot); FINAL_RANKING now -0.934. x005/x010 since computed.

x010._note: completed 2026-06-16; G_hill est from E/nu (isotropic), others direct from FINAL_RANKING. In2O3 series now complete: avg dE -0.665 (weakest of rare-earth/Sc/Y; group-13).

Gd2O3._note: STRONGEST formation of the whole M3+ series (-1.27 avg), all 3 x consistent. x010 also softest E (34.0). Top DFT-validation candidate.

x002._FLAG: ELASTIC FIT FAILED — E=110.9, G=61.9, nu=-0.10 (negative) unphysical. EXCLUDE; refit elastic.

Nd2O3._note: This is the v23 cascade QUICK-SCREEN Nd2O3 (20 structures). The Paper#2 Nd2O3 is the separate DEEP tier (tier_2026_05_16_v456_Nd2O3_6base, 5250 enum -> cfg141, DFT+U). Different pipelines; cross-compare. bvs_li_proxy 0.92 (top of series) corroborates Paper#2 'Nd preserves Li/ionic mobility; its effect is electronic'.

findings.headline_Gd2O3: Gd2O3 is the STRONGEST-forming M3+ coating dopant (-1.27 eV/atom, robust across x), clearly above Sc2O3/Y2O3. New standout vs the earlier verified-json claim of Sc2O3 (which excluded the rare earths).
findings.family_over_radius: Formation energy tracks CHEMICAL FAMILY more than ionic radius: rare-earth/Sc/Y (-0.9..-1.3) >> group-13 Ga/In (-0.6..-0.7); Al middling (-0.8). No clean monotonic radius trend.
findings.modulus: E_young 34-58 GPa (UMA scale, high vs expt; within-cascade only). Softest: Gd2O3 x010 (34.0), Ga2O3 x005 (35.8), In2O3 x005 (37.3). No clean radius trend.
findings.mobility_uniform: bvs_li_proxy ~0.83-0.92 across ALL M3+ dopants -> dopant choice barely affects Li mobility. Nd2O3 x005 = 0.92 (top), La2O3 x010 = 0.92.
findings.nd_position: Nd2O3 is a balanced mid-pack M3+ dopant (stability -0.88..-0.93 like La/Sm/Y/Sc, modulus normal, mobility top-tier 0.92) but NOT the most stable (Gd/Y/Sc beat it). Its distinctive value is ELECTRONIC (Paper#2 4f/O-passivation), an axis not scored here.
findings.paper2_crosslink: High BVSE Li-mobility proxy for Nd2O3 (0.92) independently supports Paper#2: Nd doping preserves Li (ionic) mobility; the measured conductivity drop is ELECTRONIC, not ionic.

paper3_framing: Systematic M3+ oxide coating-dopant screening for argyrodite (ionic radius 0.54-1.03 A; group-13 + Sc/Y + lanthanides), each with full stability/modulus/mobility(+ESW/e-hull) suite. Nd2O3 (Paper#2) sits inside this series. Standalone-paper thesis: 'periodic-trend screening identifies Gd/Y/Sc as most favorable trivalent oxide coatings; chemical family dominates ionic radius.'
